verdict.rationale: Railway documents its own programmatic surfaces, an official CLI and an MCP server. The MCP server lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables and redeploy services, which covers part of what the dashboard does. Nothing in the pack shows a documented public API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path, so parity with the UI is unproven. missing for 10: documented public API reference, evidence of full UI-to-API parity (canvas settings, dashboards, alerts, scaling, rollbacks), machine-readable API spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
